run_fuse_gtest: run fuse_gtest_files.py with an output directory to fuse Google Test source into single header and source files
run_fuse_gtest_with_root: run fuse_gtest_files.py with a gtest root directory and output directory to fuse all gtest files
fuse_gtest_h: fuse all gtest header files recursively into a single gtest.h output file
fuse_gtest_all_cc: fuse all gtest source files recursively into a single gtest-all.cc output file
validate_gtest_root_dir: validate that a given directory contains the required gtest seed header and source files
